meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会替你跑一次插件发布：先拟 release notes，把 8 个配置文件里的版本号统一升好，再构建、git 提交打标签并推送，创建 GitHub Release，重写 CHANGELOG。`npm publish` 这步不代跑，留给你；你确认后它再核对 npm 版本并发 Discord 通知。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 Claude Code 插件升级版本并完成发布流程时触发，例如要求 bump 到新版本、补 git tag 或创建 GitHub Release。

say.text: 给这个 Claude Code 插件按 minor 升一次级并发布。
say.note: 它会先准备 release notes，再走完整流程。

say.text: 我刚修好一个 bug，请按 patch 发成新版本。
say.note: 走完整流程，npm publish 最后留给你。

say.text: 刚才的改动是破坏性的，做一次 major 发布。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs the plugin release workflow: drafts release notes, bumps the version in all 8 manifests, builds, commits/tags/pushes, creates the GitHub Release, and regenerates CHANGELOG. `npm publish` is left to you; after confirmation it verifies the npm version and notifies Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to bump or release a version of a Claude Code plugin (e.g. new bump, git tag, GitHub Release).

say_en.text: Do a minor release for this Claude Code plugin.
say_en.note: It prepares notes first, then runs the full workflow.

say_en.text: I just fixed a bug; publish it as a patch.
say_en.note: Runs the full workflow, leaving npm publish to you.

say_en.text: The latest change is breaking; do a major release.
say_en.note: It bumps the major version and creates tag/release/changelog.
